title: Israel Strikes Nabatieh Twice, Targets Ambulance Team; House Destroyed Near Bint Jbeil
detail: Israeli warplanes carried out two back-to-back strikes on the southern city of Nabatieh, while a third strike targeted an ambulance crew responding to the attacks — the latest in a pattern of strikes on emergency responders that Lebanese officials call a violation of international humanitarian law. Separately, Israeli aircraft struck the outskirts of Sarbin near Haris in the Bint Jbeil district and completely destroyed a house between Haddatha and Haris; artillery also shelled the outskirts of Haddatha. No casualties were confirmed in initial reports.

media.caption: Israeli strikes hit Nabatieh twice and target an ambulance team responding to the attacks, Sep 19, 2026
